Can my predator play a Special Report to untap one of his vampires
when one of my minions declares a bleed against my prey?

Vegas gNat

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
tigernat1 wrote:
> Can my predator play a Special Report to untap one of his vampires
> when one of my minions declares a bleed against my prey?

Not in general, since the would-be target cannot attempt to block.

If the vampire is capable of blocking at the time Special Report is played,
though, sure.
